subagent_input.last_assistant_message: Extracted 4 falsifiable claims from the GitHub issue. This is a forum-type source (vendor issue tracker, user-reported) directly relevant to section 4 of the research question — clipboard image handling in terminal workflows. Key confirmation: the TTY cannot receive image bytes directly, so apps like Claude Code read the system clipboard via platform APIs (pbpaste/NSPasteboard), and tmux's paste path only forwards text. Note the OSC 52 / pbpaste mechanism is the reporter's hypothesis, not confirmed by Anthropic; the issue was closed as not planned.
